title: Cascader
description: A select that walks a tree: pick a branch, then a branch of the branch, until the leaf is the answer.
usage: For choices that are really addresses — region, category, org chart. The author writes the tree as nested lists in the panel; the script deals it into columns. The trigger shows the whole path, because the leaf alone ("Central") rarely says enough.
a11y: The trigger is a button with aria-expanded; columns are lists and items are buttons, the chosen path announced in the trigger text. Arrow-key column navigation is the app’s layer; Escape closes from anywhere.
